title: Trying to make my first game ever
author: AbjectPainting4162
selftext:
Hi, I’ve been wanting to make a simple 2D game with different gathering and crafting mechanics for a long time. I have no experience on coding nor using any game engine. Can I use Godot and connect codex (or any other ai, I have no problems with token costs) and build the game with it? I have no intentions of making money off of this project. (I don’t have pixel assets too, I was thinking about using pixellab)

Thanks,

comments.author: pirondi
comments.body: Browser first is easyer. Later go to game engines.

replies.author: AbjectPainting4162
replies.body: Yeah but I wonder if godot can be used with ai to build the game in my case or I can’t rely on ai to make the game on godot?

replies.author: woodysixer
replies.body: 100% you can. I’m building a Godot game with Claude Code right now.

replies.author: AbjectPainting4162
replies.body: Alright thank you, what should I use for pixel art asset generations?

replies.author: woodysixer
replies.body: Try spritecook.ai, but use it via MCP. Your AI will write better prompts than you will. It’s really impressed me.

comments.author: stayhappyenjoylife
comments.body: Yes of course. plan n create gdd of ur simple 2d game with codex. Not all 2D games need to use a game engine. Ask it to implement gdd as a indie developer with milestones. Images can b made using AI as well. Don't try to one shot build ur game. Build, play , give feedback to codex and continue this loop.

replies.author: AbjectPainting4162
replies.body: Thanks for the reply, wheat about the optimization part? Is Ai good at that area because as I said I don’t have coding experience and I don’t know the fancy tricks

replies.author: stayhappyenjoylife
replies.body: U can research and learn the theory of how optimization is done by gaming studios for the game genre that u intend to make. And ask codex to apply it. Since ur building 2d, ul not face the challenges that one faces while building 3D games which needs optimization more. My personal experience is codex gpt-sol-5.6-high tries to write the best code with all possible scenarios being handled.

comments.author: woodysixer
comments.body: I’m currently making my first game with Claude, Godot and spritecook.ai for graphics. It’s going great.

replies.author: AbjectPainting4162
replies.body: That sounds great, what are you using for optimization tho? I saw devs using magic tricks to optimize their games on the devlogs, is Ai strong on this?

replies.author: woodysixer
replies.body: Why are you worried about optimization before you even start building anything? Optimizing what?

comments.author: rhinoceros100
comments.body:
